description: This file defines API routes for geographical data querying in a FastAPI application. It includes two endpoints: one for spatial bounding box queries and another for proximity searches, both interacting with a MongoDB database to retrieve location-based image data.

methods.name: progress_in_bbox( min_lon: float = Query(...), min_lat: float = Query(...), max_lon: float = Query(...), max_lat: float = Query(...), )
methods.description: Asynchronous handler for fetching progress images within a specified bounding box.

methods.name: progress_near(lon: float = Query(...), lat: float = Query(...), max_distance_m: int = Query(1000))
methods.description: Asynchronous handler for fetching progress images near a given point within a specified maximum distance.
